# Xito Freelancer

> Portfolio, discovery, and booking platform for wedding photographers, videographers and event creatives in Nepal.

Xito Freelancer lets wedding creatives in Nepal showcase their work, get discovered by couples and agencies, and manage bookings, clients and crew from one app.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Personalized feed of wedding creatives, posts and shoots.
- [Discover](/discover): Browse photographers, videographers and other wedding freelancers across Nepal.
- [Market](/market): Community marketplace for gigs, gear and collaborations.
- [Xito Events](/xito-events): Featured weddings and event showcases.
- [Lagan](/lagan): Auspicious Nepali wedding dates (Lagan calendar).
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create a Xito Freelancer account.
